migration_review.disposition: umbra-process-profile-source-test-dependency-to-ship
migration_review.evidence_note: Reviewed the implementation and its source wiring. Client and server contexts are constrained to TLS 1.3. The default server-certificate mode verifies the peer through the system or configured trust store and checks the requested host; encryption-only disables certificate verification but retains TLS and SNI. Handshake deadlines and setup failures close the socket, and no plaintext fallback exists. The code is part of the 2025 umbra_rti target; TLS is private process-transport behavior, not an HLA requirement.
